note.headline: A productive week that made DS1/DS2 splitting more trustworthy, with active avoidance continuing at the bench.
note.summary: The week's work centred on the dentate spike pipeline. The Extraction Room is now complete, and we found and fixed a splitting rule that was partly counting a notch inside a sink as a second sink. The PTEN and CTL Baseline event set was rebuilt without P-spike overlap, 4,177 events, and no recording's verdict changed. Joe's 23 Aim 2 follow-up requests are done. Active avoidance continued across five mice, and no new recordings arrived.
progress: The Extraction Room is complete and compares DS1 and DS2 by recording, PTEN against control and by knockout dose.
The DS1/DS2 splitting rule now uses each recording's two main sink regions. This removes an artefact where a notch was counted as a second sink.
Root Canal gained a Meta Workflow, Box and Snap borders and an optional Halo step for events near both borders.
The PTEN and CTL Baseline set was rebuilt without P-spike overlap, 4,177 events, and no recording's verdict changed.
Root Canal can read many recordings at once on the VACC. A test on two took 5 min 10 s.
Joe's 23 Aim 2 follow-up requests are all in a new tab, and Setup is now one pass on a new computer.
bench: Active avoidance ran on mice 1652, 1658 and 1663 on 11-06, with a second session on 11-07.
Active avoidance ran on mice 1653 and 1659 on 11-12, with a second session on 11-13.
Angelina led most sessions, and Avery, Maddie and Samara led the last two.
The colony stands at 80 animals alive (76 stock, 4 mating).
data: Two bank entries were updated across 13 versions, with 9,025 dentate spikes in total.
The automatic model Prospector made 5 calls, and no person made calls this week.
next: Continue refining the Root Canal event sets.
watch: 23 code files are changed but not yet committed. They are in hand with the next commits.
The daily error review found and fixed five small faults this week, none affecting data.
